items.statement: Cash flows from operations improved 321.86% to Rs. 67.54 crores in H1 FY25.
items.quote: Cash flows from operation significantly improved by 321.86% reaching Rs. 67.54 crores.

items.statement: Management received 40-45% of overdue payments from Middle East and Southeast Asia channel partners, expects 75-80% collection within two months, and targets 100% recovery.
items.quote: We have already received 40% to 45% of the payments from those partners and balance is also coming in due course. In another month or two, I think almost 75%-80% should be cleared.

items.statement: CFO assures investors that debtor collection is on track with micromanagement, targeting 70-80% by December and 100% eventually.
items.quote: We are doing a very micromanagement thing on that. And we want to assure all the investors that we will be able to collect the data as sir rightly said, by December we will be able to cover 70%-80% and our target is to collect the entire 100%.

items.statement: Equity capital remained unchanged year-on-year as of H1 FY25

items.quote: The confirmed order book of KP Group we have not shown it over here. So that is approximately, see KPI is going to set up 1.3 gigawatt of IP P plant. So automatically all the requirements will come to KP Green Engineering.

items.statement: Inventory increased from INR15.64 cr to INR21.7 cr; debtors rose due to 40% revenue booked in September with 30-45 day collection cycle, causing negative operating cash flow
items.quote: If we went to the debtor side, debtors is a little bit higher, the reason is being that -- means we book approx 40 % revenue in September month itself . August-September month itself , so the cycle is 30 to 45 days. For that reason the debtor realization is not happened on 30th September.

items.statement: Director Saiyyed Owais Ali deposited INR100 cr in personal name for Bhukia-Jagpura Gold Mine upfront payment; operations will flow to company
items.quote: We have given NSE that a Director Saiyyed Owais Ali and his name has given INR100 crores by capital for the up-front payment of the Bhukia-Jagpura Gold Mine and we are with up with the government for the further process

items.statement: Gold mine held in director's personal name due to net worth requirements for bidding; future transfer to company planned
items.quote: This is not on the personal it's because they were needing more network actually the process of bidding and the technical qualification they want more so it was on my personal name that's why we have bidded from the personal name.

items.statement: Inventory at INR21.7 cr as of 30 Sep 2024 vs INR15.64 cr in FY24; maintained for 3-month production requirement
items.quote: I want to tell you the inventory, if you see the inventory level which is around INR15.64 crores in financial '24. And right now it is INR21.7 crores on 30th September '24.

items.statement: Suven has a cash reserve of 6.5 billion as of September 24 to support the strategic investment.
items.quote: s strong balance sheet with a cash reserve of 6.5 billion as of September 24 positions us well to support the strategic investment

items.statement: Acquisition financed through 45% equity swap and 55% cash consideration
items.quote: The acquisition will be financed through a combination of 45% equity swap and 55% cash consideration.

items.statement: Metropolis remains zero-debt with cash and cash equivalents of around INR 187 crores as of September 2024
items.quote: Metropolis remains a zero -debt company with cash and cash equivalents of around INR 187 crores as of September 2024.

items.statement: Management says they are optimizing working capital and improving cash flow management as a key priority for H2 FY25.
items.quote: continuing to optimize the working capital and improve cash flow management

items.statement: Cash flow from operations negative in current quarter due to increase in unbilled revenues and reduction in trade payables by around INR105 crores; expected to turn positive in future quarters
items.quote: For the current quarter, our cash flow from operations has been negative. It is basically because of an increase in the unbilled revenues and a trade payable which has got reduced by around INR105 crores.

items.statement: Warrant funds have not been received yet; company is awaiting in-principle approval from SEBI after answering their questions.
items.quote: Warrants funds have not come in. We are still waiting for in principle approval from SEBI. So SEBI has raised many questions, and we are answering those questions. So warrant funds have not come in yet.

items.statement: Marketing spend is kept at 30-35% of revenue; CAC is about 35%.
items.quote: What is our marketing spend percentage of revenue? Do we have a ceiling? So we try to keep it around 30 to 35%. CAC is about 35%.

items.statement: GPIL acquired 35% stake in JPL via CCPS at INR297 each, convertible 1:1 into equity at INR287 premium
items.quote: Out of INR175 crores of funds infused into JPL, INR75 crores is used for acquiring remaining stake of promoters held in various group companies, associate companies, partnership firms and proprietorship firms.

items.statement: GPIL acquired 14% stake from JPL promoters for INR79.52 crores, balance 2% to be acquired after conditions precedent
items.quote: Further, GPIL has acquired 14% stake from JPL promoters for a cost of INR79.52 crores and balance 2% shall be acquired by JPL after compliance of condition precedence.

items.statement: JPL received INR35 crores GST refund in FY24 from Jammu & Kashmir operations
items.quote: In FY '24 in Jammu and Kashmir, we have almost 50% turnover in Jammu and Kashmir. So quantum is around INR35 crores.

items.statement: Acquisition funded through wholly owned subsidiary SPR Engenious Limited at enterprise value of INR 2,200 million on debt-free, cash-free basis
items.quote: SPR Engenious Limited will acquire a 100% shareholding in TGPEL at an enterprise value of INR2,200 million on a debt-free, cash-free basis, with adjustments of debt and debt-like items to be considered as on the date of the closing.

items.statement: Revenue recognition in Q4 FY25 will be nil; revenue will start from Q1 FY26 country by country, with full control expected by FY27
items.quote: revenue recognition in Q4 of this financial year would be nil, because b ayer will do business as usual on behalf of Dhanuka, will get the sort of royalty. Revenue will not come in our books in this financial year. However, revenue will start coming from the next financial year

items.statement: Net working capital days currently 112-120 days; overall NWC should not increase with the two new molecules and may improve over time
items.quote: Currently, we are having the NWC is around 112 days to 120 days. So, overall, NWC should not see increase at all, even by this introduction of these two molecules.

items.statement: Trade receivables rose from INR10.52 crore at FY24 end to INR30.82 crore in H1 FY25 due to large advisory deals closed in Q2 with structured payment terms.
items.quote: The trade receivables have increased from INR10.52 crores in financial year '24 to INR30.82 crores in H1 financial year '25. This increase is on account of large advisory services done in quarter 2.

items.statement: Cash and cash equivalents decreased by about INR2 crore in H1 FY25 versus an increase of INR1.19 crore in H1 FY24, driven by the receivables build-up.
items.quote: With a net decrease in cash and cash equivalent of about INR2 crores versus an increase of INR1.19 crores in H1 '24. This is also because of the increase in the receivables in quarter 2 in financial year '25.

items.statement: Management collected about INR15 crore of receivables in H1 FY25, covering the INR10.5 crore opening balance plus INR5 crore of current period billings.
items.quote: We collected about INR15 crores already. So, we collected the INR10 crores that was due as of March plus another INR5 crores of this year, leaving us effectively about INR30 crore s of receivables

items.statement: All receivables are current, being paid per schedule, with zero write-offs or concerns.
items.quote: Absolutely. So, we have no concern in terms of receivables. All receivables are standard. All receivables are current. All receivables are being paid as per their payment schedule. And therefore, we have zero write-offs or zero concerns with receivables.

items.statement: Receivables may remain elevated at FY25 end because H2 deal closures will generate fresh invoices with 30-120 day payment terms.
items.quote: What we'll finish in H2, might stay outstanding to some extent.
